mapper.select: SELECT p.default_funding_channel_id, f.display_name AS funding_channel_name, p.ledger_default_range, p.report_default_range, p.theme_mode, p.recent_entry_type, p.updated_at, COALESCE(f.status = 'ACTIVE', false) AS funding_channel_active FROM user_preference p LEFT JOIN funding_channel f ON f.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND f.id = p.default_funding_channel_id WHERE p.user_id = #{p.userId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM funding_channel WHERE id = #{p.id} AND status = 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: INSERT INTO user_preference( tenant_id, user_id, default_funding_channel_id, ledger_default_range, report_default_range, theme_mode, recent_entry_type, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid, #{p.userId}, #{p.fundingChannelId}, #{p.ledgerRange}, #{p.reportRange}, #{p.themeMode}, #{p.entryType}, #{p.now}, #{p.now} ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, user_id) DO UPDATE SET default_funding_channel_id = EXCLUDED.default_funding_channel_id, ledger_default_range = EXCLUDED.ledger_default_range, report_default_range = EXCLUDED.report_default_range, theme_mode = EXCLUDED.theme_mode, recent_entry_type = EXCLUDED.recent_entry_type, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
